description: WeChat AHP telemetry is enabled in all extension modes, including F5/development and tests. Logical event names are namespaced by the VS Code telemetry logger. Global all permits usage and errors; error permits errors only; crash/off permit neither. Host-enforced logging-only mode, including the official VS Code extension test host, is respected. No message, account, binding, resource, path, credential, or raw error data is collected.

common.common.vscodemachineid: VS Code-generated pseudonymous machine identifier; not linked to WeChat or AHP.
common.common.vscodesessionid: VS Code-generated pseudonymous session identifier; not linked to WeChat or AHP.
common.common.sqmid: Standard VS Code pseudonymous device identifier, when supplied by the logger; not linked to WeChat or AHP.
common.common.devDeviceId: Standard VS Code pseudonymous development-device identifier, when supplied by the logger; not linked to WeChat or AHP.
common.common.vscodereleasedate: VS Code build release date, when supplied by the logger.
common.common.isAgentsWindow: Whether the VS Code host is an Agents window, when supplied by the logger.
common.common.uikind: Desktop or web UI kind; this extension supports desktop only.
common.common.remotename: Normalized remote kind, not a hostname; remote workspaces are unsupported.
common.common.isnewappinstall: Standard VS Code install-state metadata, when supplied by the logger.

envelope.ext.user.id: SDK derives this from VS Code machineId; the ingestion envelope may represent it as ai.user.id.
envelope.ext.user.authId: SDK derives this from VS Code machineId; the ingestion envelope may represent it as ai.user.authUserId. This is not a WeChat account.
envelope.ext.app.sesId: SDK derives this from VS Code sessionId; the ingestion envelope may represent it as ai.session.id.
envelope.metadata: Application Insights adds the event timestamp, SDK version, event type and ingestion-resource identifier. No custom tags or identifiers are added.

duration_ms.description: Optional rounded local elapsed milliseconds. Login/connect timing starts after sync/QR consent, not while waiting for the initial dialog. Not a message-delivery measurement.
